observations.behavior: Adds a new 'window' property to HogFlowConversionApi and HogFlowApi, replacing the numeric 'window_minutes' with a duration-string format.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows workflow conversion goals to specify a conversion window as a duration string (e.g., '7d', '12h') instead of minutes, potentially changing API compatibility and client behavior.

observations.behavior: Updates comments and documentation to mark 'window_minutes' as deprecated and describe the new 'window' property.
